$comment: The number of interactive elements the GUI suite actually activates, held by scripts/check-gui-coverage.py --gate. Raise it when it rises; lowering it is a decision to write down, not a way to make CI pass.
$margin: None. The figure was held four below the observed count while activation depended on which controls a headless platform materializes and only macOS had ever reported one. Run 34083254795 reported 159 on ubuntu-latest, the same count macOS reports, so the margin bought nothing and hid four elements' worth of regression.
